Sardar Veerender Singh vs The State Of Telangana on 21 July,
2023
 1
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice G. Anupama Chakravarthy
 Criminial Petition No.6355 Of 2023
O R D E R:

entities.text: Sardar Veerender Singh vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner- Accused No.6 to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.246 of 2022 pending on the file of Karimnagar (I Town) Police Station, Karimnagar, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467 & 471 of Indian Penal Code (for short "IPC").
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri S.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.

3. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner/accused No.6 that the petitioner/accused No.6 is residing at Farmington Hills, Michigan State, United States of America (for short "U.S.A.") and that the petitioner/accused No.6 is coming to India today and he is ready to cooperate with the investigation and therefore, prayed to direct the police not to arrest or to take any coercive steps against the petitioner/accused No.6.

The learned counsel for the petitioner/accused No.6 has stated that accused Nos.1, 2, 4 and 5 in the very same crime has filed Crl.P.No.10508 of 2022 and the same was disposed of by this Court on 28.11.2022 directing the "Investigating Officer in Crime No.246 of 2022 pending on the file of Karimnagar (I Town) Police Station, Karimnagar,
not to arrest these petitioners and conclude the investigation on the basis of the explanation given by these petitioners.

Further, the petitioners-Accused Nos.1,2,4 & 5 shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation", therefore, prayed to extend the same benefit to the petitioner/accused No.6 also.

4. Taking into consideration the fact that petitioner/accused No.6 is coming to India today and he is ready to cooperate with the investigation, he is directed to appear before the Investigation Officer in Crime No.246 of 2022 pending on the file of Karimnagar (I Town) Police Station, Karimnagar, on 27.07.2023 and on his appearance, the Investigation Officer is directed not to arrest the petitioner/accused No.6 and shall receive the explanation given by the him and conclude the investigation.

Further the petitioner/accused No.6 is directed to produce his aadhar card and all the documents related to his identity and address of his residence in Hyderabad as well as in U.S.A.
5.
Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed off.
